## Labcoat Leni 15.1

Matthews et al. (2007): *Having a quail of a time?*

Do males fertilize more eggs when mating in the context that signalled a mating opportunity?

- `signalled`: eggs fertilized in the male's signalled context
- `control`: eggs fertilized in the male's control context
- Both males mated with the same 14 females

[Data (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_data/data/matthews_2007.jasp) · [Results (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_15a.jasp) · [Results (.html)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_15a.html)

## Labcoat Leni 15.2

Çetinkaya & Domjan (2006): *Eggs-traordinary*

Do fetishistic quail fertilize more eggs and initiate sex more quickly?

- `groups`: fetishistic, non-fetishistic or control
- `egg_percent`: percentage of eggs fertilized
- `latency`: time taken to initiate copulation

[Data (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_data/data/cetinkaya_2006.jasp) · [Results (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_15b.jasp) · [Results (.html)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_15b.html)
